FINAL SQL:
WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS match_wins
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT winner_id, match_wins
    FROM win_counts
    ORDER BY match_wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_ranking AS (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.ranking_points
    FROM rankings r
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_id, MAX(ranking_date) AS max_date
        FROM rankings
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) md ON r.player_id = md.player_id AND r.ranking_date = md.max_date
)
SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name, lr.ranking_points
FROM max_wins mw
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = mw.winner_id
JOIN latest_ranking lr ON lr.player_id = p.player_id;
